I compared the lowest‑MSRP U.S. trim for each model (you didn’t pick trims, so I used the lowest‑MSRP available for each):
• 2027 CX‑5 — trim used: us-2027-cx5-2-5-s-suv-awd-6at-2r (2.5 S). MSRP $29,990; destination $1,595. (Model is gasoline powertrain.)
• 2027 CX‑90 Plug‑in Hybrid — trim used: us-2027-cx90-phev-phev-preferred-suv-awd-8at-3r (PHEV Preferred). MSRP $50,695; destination $1,645. (Model powertrain: plug_in_hybrid.)

blocks.text:
Summary of the comparison (sourced 2026-11-13):
- Powertrain: CX‑5 (gasoline only per the U.S. catalog); CX‑90 PHEV (plug‑in hybrid — Mazda lists a 17.8 kWh battery and an EPA electric range up to 27 miles for the PHEV Preferred). 
- Size & seating: CX‑5 is a two‑row five‑seat compact SUV; CX‑90 PHEV is a larger three‑row seven‑seat SUV. 
- Performance & capability (selected specs): CX‑5 2.5 S: SKYACTIV‑G 2.5L I4 (187 hp / 186 lb‑ft), EPA AWD mpg 24 city / 30 hwy (catalog). CX‑90 PHEV Preferred: combined system ~323 hp / 369 lb‑ft (catalog), electric range up to 27 miles (catalog). 
- Price: CX‑5 base trim $29,990 vs CX‑90 PHEV Preferred $50,695 (MSRPs; each excludes destination, taxes, title, options and dealer fees).

Caveats and next steps:
- All numbers, trims and MSRPs are from Mazda U.S. catalog material checked 2026-11-13; I used the exact trim IDs returned by the catalog. 
- The CX‑5 2027 U.S. catalog shows only gasoline trims (no PHEV listed). 
- If you want a side‑by‑side of different CX‑90 PHEV trims or a different CX‑5 trim, tell me which trims (or I can compare the next‑lowest CX‑5 trim).
